shadows.name: action-lift
shadows.purpose: Primary actions and active work surfaces.

shadows.name: panel-lift
shadows.purpose: One dominant work panel per task region.

motion.name: state-fast
motion.purpose: Button, filter, and row state feedback.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main deliberate action on a governance screen.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 44px; padding: 12px 16px; border: 2px solid #0F1412; border-radius: 0; background: #FF6B35; color: #0F1412; font: 800 12px/1.2 Raleway, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .06em; box-shadow: 6px 6px 0 #0F1412; transition: transform 180ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), box-shadow 180ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-button-primary:hover, .ds-button-primary:active { transform: translate(6px, 6px); box-shadow: none; } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0F1412; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A secondary action with the same tactile vocabulary.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { min-height: 44px; padding: 12px 16px; border: 2px solid #0F1412; border-radius: 0; background: #FCFDF8; color: #0F1412; font: 800 12px/1.2 Raleway, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .06em; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { background: #F3F5F0; } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.60 0.13 163); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Governance Input
components.description: A labelled, square field for filters and review metadata.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: #0F1412; font: 800 12px/1.2 Raleway, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .06em; } .ds-field input { min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 12px; border: 2px solid #0F1412; border-radius: 0; background: #FCFDF8; color: #0F1412; font: 500 14px/1.5 Raleway, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.60 0.13 163); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: A non-color-only control or evidence state.
components.css: .ds-status-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 28px; padding: 4px 8px; border: 2px solid #0F1412; border-radius: 0; background: #F3F5F0; color: #0F1412; font: 800 11px/1.2 Raleway, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .05em; }

components.name: Control Trace Row
components.description: The signature scan line for control, evidence, and finding traceability.
components.css: .ds-control-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 90px minmax(220px,1fr) 130px 100px; gap: 12px; align-items: center; min-height: 52px; padding: 10px 12px; border-bottom: 2px solid #0F1412; background: #FCFDF8; color: #0F1412; font: 500 14px/1.4 Raleway, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-control-row:hover { background: #F3F5F0; } .ds-control-row:focus-within { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.60 0.13 163); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-control-state { font-weight: 800; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: .05em; }

narrative.overview: FairMind is a shared technical workbench for engineers, compliance leads, and auditors. It is dense enough for evidence review, calm enough for sustained work, and explicit about what is observed, inferred, accepted, failed, or unknown.
keyCharacteristics: System-first navigation with a framework lens.
Visible provenance, freshness, ownership, and review status.
Strong borders and selective hard shadows.

rules.name: The Evidence Color Rule
rules.body: Color may reinforce a labelled state, but color alone never carries readiness, severity, freshness, or review meaning.

rules.name: The Orange Action Rule
rules.body: Orange identifies an action or active task. If orange covers an entire dashboard region, it has been overused.

rules.name: The Scan First Rule
rules.body: A reviewer must identify scope, status, owner, and next action without reading paragraph text.

rules.name: The Flat By Default Rule
rules.body: Tables, toolbars, filters, and nested content remain flat. A shadow must explain interaction or hierarchy.

dos: Do show company, AI system, framework version, and review period before readiness information.
Do use shared controls and reviewed evidence links across frameworks.
Do use tables and split views for dense governance work.
donts: Don't use purple gradients, gradient text, glassmorphism, neon glow, or generic AI product styling.
Don't place marketing heroes inside the authenticated dashboard.
Don't imply that a score, accepted artifact, or FairMind evaluation automatically proves compliance or certification.
